concerns.text: Task T039 proposes using `git clone --depth 1` or `git archive` to minimize disk usage. This violates Spec FR-001 and Plan requirements for verifying `is_fresh_commit` status and repository history (≥5 years). A shallow clone truncates history, making it impossible to verify the 'fresh commit' constraint or the 5-year age requirement, effectively weakening the data collection constraint.

Task T022.5 selects 'Python Standard Library v3.12.0' as a reference set but lacks an explicit instruction to verify the checksum of the specific commit SHA against a known canonical manifest. This risks violating Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Principle I (Reproducibility) if the upstream tag changes, as the task does not mandate fetching from a fixed, checksum-verified source on every run.

Task T028 defines sensitivity analysis verification as a binary 'pass/fail' based on sign consistency. Spec SC-005 requires 'Threshold Robustness' as a measurable success criterion. The task fails to capture the magnitude of stability or the specific threshold ranges where results flip, rendering the acceptance criterion partially unmeasurable and weakening the robustness requirement.

Task T041 introduces a 'GitHub API Rate Limit Monitoring Dashboard' as a new feature. The Spec and Plan only require 'Rate Limit Handling' (exponential backoff) within collection scripts (T012, T013). This constitutes scope creep and introduces a silent simplification/fallback mechanism (a dashboard) not mandated by the spec, violating the principle of not introducing unrequested complexity or artifacts.
